dialogues.speaker: Note About Sumpter Beasts
dialogues.text: "...We've got the Sumpter Beasts. Now we just need to use them to transport the goods to our station in the western mountains."

dialogues.speaker: Note About Sumpter Beasts
dialogues.text: "...Escort Personnel, Take Note: Most of the Sumpter Beasts are suffering from malnutrition. Please ensure that they have enough water and food, and only depart after they've regained their strength!"
